pages.text:
## Exam
T 98.6F HR 96 BP 138/84 RR 20 SpO2 95% RA
Gen: uncomfortable with deep breath, AOx4
Chest: tenderness R lateral chest wall ribs 5-7, no crepitus, no paradoxical movement, breath sounds equal bilaterally
Skin: no open wounds, small abrasion R elbow, cleaned, no dressing needed
Psych: calm, appropriate, normal mood and affect
## Assessment/Plan
Closed nondisplaced fractures R ribs 5-7, mechanical fall. No pneumothorax.
1. Multimodal pain control: acetaminophen scheduled, lidocaine patch, oxycodone PRN
2. Incentive spirometry q1h while awake, RT to teach
3. Repeat CXR in AM to confirm no delayed pneumothorax
4. PT/OT
5. Dispo: unhoused, CM consult for recuperative care
Signed: Petra Lindqvist, MD 09/01/2026 00:20
